svg.title: Catalyst Cat compact animated character sheet — hovering streak
svg.desc: A faithful compact conversion of the approved Catalyst Cat with eight animated states: idle, welcome, thinking, celebration, guide, correct, reassure, and honest streak concern with the streak icon hovering over an upturned paw.
